content.text:
Base directory for this skill: D:\Apps\micro1-frontier-hackathon\runtime\.claude\skills\aliasbreaker

Run one AliasBreaker campaign following the protocol in CLAUDE.md exactly.

- CASE = the fixture path given in the arguments (e.g.
  `../data/cases/dev/case-101.json`).
- RUN = `runs/<run-id>` if a run id was given, else `runs/<case-id>-manual`.

Begin with `start`, follow the decision guidance, and end with `finalize`.
All hard rules in CLAUDE.md apply unchanged.


ARGUMENTS: ../data/cases/dev/case-109.json runs/dev-v1-case-109-r1

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-109-r1 --slot 0 --why "Slot 0 separates the leading pairs 0-1 and 0-2 at max 4-sigma, the best early discriminator among top candidates"
python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-109-r1 --slot 8 --why "Slot 8 gives 4-sigma separation for the now-leading pair 0 vs 1 while preserving later slots for a confirmation point"

content.text: Candidate 1 crossed theta after just 2 observations — per protocol, spending one confirmation observation on the leading pair before finalizing.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli observe --run runs/dev-v1-case-109-r1 --slot 9 --why "Confirmation point at 4-sigma separation for the surviving pair 0 vs 1 before finalizing on candidate 1"

content.text: Confirmed: candidate 1 support 0.9998, well above theta. Finalizing.

input.command: python -m aliasbreaker.cli finalize --run runs/dev-v1-case-109-r1 --why "Candidate 1 (P=12.9642d) confirmed at support 0.9998 after two discriminating observations plus a confirmation point, exceeding theta"

content.text:
Campaign complete for case-109.

- **Result:** Resolved — candidate 1 (P = 12.9642 d) selected with support 0.9998, exceeding θ = 0.997.
- **Observations used:** 3 of 6 (slots 0, 8, 9).
- **Path:** Slot 0 broke the initial 3-way tie (0/1/2), collapsing candidates 3–5 to ~0 and lifting candidate 1 to 0.358. Slot 8 discriminated the 0-vs-1 pair directly, pushing candidate 1 to 0.998 — already past θ but only after 2 observations, so per protocol I spent one confirmation observation (slot 9) at another 4σ-separating point for the same pair, which held at 0.9998. Finalized with 3 observations unused (budget_left = 3).
